# Specification-Driven Coding — Write Blueprint

Write a Vertical Blueprint Contract before implementation.

Official pipeline: Raw request -> Intake -> Specification -> Project Profile Selection -> Vertical Blueprint -> Plan -> Tasks -> Implementation -> Evaluation Scorecard -> Release/Iteration.

Required sections:
- Role contract
- Domain contract
- Mode contract
- Scope/non-goals
- Stack decision space
- File tree contract
- Architecture/data/API/tool contracts
- UX/design/motion contract
- Security hardening
- Performance budget
- Testing contract
- Output contract
- Scorecard

Do not write code until the blueprint passes the audit.
